Card Q&A.a: Yes. The effects on both Digimon activate, so you gain 2 memory.
Card Q&A.q: I have 2 copies of this Digimon in my battle area. If I play a Tamer with [Tai Kamiya] in its name, can I activate the effects on both Digimon to gain a total of 2 memory?
